_readme: Smoke-level retrieval check, NOT a benchmark. Labels are keyword based: a retrieved chunk counts as relevant when it comes from one of expected_papers AND its text matches ANY of the regex patterns (case-insensitive).

To add a query: append an object to 'queries' with id, kind ('in_domain' or 'out_of_domain'), query, and for in-domain queries expected_papers (paper ids from db/seed_data/papers.json) and patterns (regular expressions a relevant chunk must contain).

Write expectations from what the documents are about BEFORE looking at what the retriever returns; do not tune patterns to the results. Run: python -m app.eval_retrieval (add --check-patterns to see that every pattern occurs in the expected papers).
